year, month, day, and hour land as DECIMAL(38,9) with integral min/max/distinct_values and are cast to INTEGER; temp, dewp, humid, wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, precip, pressure, and visib land as DECIMAL(38,9) with fractional samples and are cast to fixed-precision DECIMAL/number types matching their observed decimal scale.

purpose: This table provides hourly weather observations (temperature, dew point, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, visibility) for three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) in 2013, cleaned from the raw bronze capture for use in flight-delay or operations analysis joins keyed by station and hour.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to attach weather context to flight or operational events; consumers must handle nulls explicitly in wind_dir, wind_speed, pressure, and especially wind_gust (74.6% null) rather than assuming zero or average values, since nulls represent missing instrument readings, not absence of wind or pressure.
limitations: wind_gust is missing for about 74.6% of rows and pressure for about 11.5%, so any aggregate or model relying on them must account for substantial sparsity; wind_dir and wind_speed have small but nonzero null rates (1.68% and 0.015% respectively); the dataset covers only 2013 (year has a single distinct value) and only three origin airports, so it cannot be used to infer weather at other stations or other years.
